findings.finding: leaf_only does not enforce no-transit at this upstream pin. Withdraw initial inference that the flag establishes caller/transit separation.

An endpoint-only or transit-is-opt-in assurance needs separate tested enforcement. Actual forwarding activity requires its own infrastructure/privacy and conditional telecoms, PECR and IPA assessment.
Forwarding does not automatically make every endpoint a provider of an underlying user-to-user service. Actual application admission and service control remain separate questions.
A future remote gateway needs separate assessment of opaque forwarding, room authority, accounts, media-key termination and recording.
The bounded local fixture is not evidence that a public calling service is exempt from the OSA.
